assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Circular cross-section of the clarinet with centre O and the blue water level line 2 below O; the region of the circle below the line is shaded. Dashed radii of length 4 go from O to the ends of the chord, and a dashed segment of length 2 from O down to the chord. A double arrow at the left shows that the water level is 2 above the bottom of the circle.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
